name: agent-tuneup
description: Audit and align centralized T3 provider wiring, shared rules, skills, permissions and MCPs with approved native changes.
short_description: Audit and align centralized T3 provider wiring
argument_hint: doctor | audit | audit --provider NAME --settings PATH | audit --t3-projects | align | apply --plan PATH | scan --provider claude

workers.responsibility: Research exact provider configuration format and scope semantics with authoritative source citations.
Verify only explicitly authorized proposed or applied changes. Separate parse, load, and live enforcement evidence.

doctor.reason: Local adapter readiness has no synthesis.

scan.reason: Requested transcript frequencies are diagnostics, never permission recommendations.
scan.completion_evidence: observed provider configuration; authored recommendations require admission

audit.reason: Review cross-scope conclusions and substantive bootstrap recommendations including no-change; raw single-file diagnostic and mechanical template stay direct.
audit.completion_evidence: reviewed conclusions; raw audit is direct until conclusions are authored

align.reason: Review integrated conclusions and private proposals before concrete owner approval, including no-change.
align.completion_evidence: reviewed concrete proposal and authorised verified application

apply.reason: Reuse the scoped agreement and producing evidence without chooser; reconcile owned handles and retain findings/budgets.
apply.completion_evidence: existing approved proposal applied and verified
